To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of visual analytics in the Big Data Analytics arena is not only feasible but can also be quite powerful.

visual analytics is a promising new field of study, and it is likely to be successful if it focuses on the development and application of methods that combine the strengths of human and machine intelligence.

1) visual analytics is the combination of the analytic methods of data mining, machine learning, and statistical analysis with the methods of visualization to create a system that supports the analysis process; 2) visual analytics can be used to support the analysis of large, heterogeneous, and complex data sets in a variety of application domains; 3) visual analytics is not a single, well defined, or even well understood discipline, but rather is an emerging field that is still in its infancy;
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing methods and tools to enable users to explore, understand, and interact with very large data sets.
the development of interactive visualization systems that can be used to explore and analyze large data sets.

the following: (1) the development of a general framework for interactive visual analysis, (2) the development of interactive visual analysis methods for the analysis of large data sets, and (3) the design of visual analytics systems for specific application areas.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the future of Big Data Analytics is in visual analytics.
the future of data visualization is bright.
Big Data Analytics is a big deal and that it is here to stay.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the integration of interactive visualization with automated methods can be a very powerful approach to data exploration.
we have shown that the combination of visual analysis and automated analysis can be a powerful approach to solving problems.
visual analytics is the science of analytical reasoning facilitated by interactive visual interfaces, and the practice of analytical reasoning facilitated through interactive visual interfaces.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the combination of visualization and automated analysis can be used to provide a new level of insight into large and complex data sets that are too large and complex to be analyzed by traditional methods.
visualization and analytics are not competing technologies, but rather they are complementary and can be used to great effect when combined.
visualization is a key component of the analysis process, and that it can be used to guide and improve the analysis process.
